explanation_of_discrepancy: The sum of treatment rows across categories exceeds unique initiation episodes because: (1) Patients frequently receive concurrent multimodal treatments (e.g. Norepinephrine infusion titrated concurrently with Vancomycin infusion and Furosemide administration), (2) Continuous IV infusions are logged as multiple successive bag adjustments/rate changes in inputevents, and (3) Prescriptions and inputevents capture both order generation and bedside administration.
